author: golem
body:
# Failed run safely closed; no snapshot recreation

Read teardown immediately. Preserve SIGINT(-2)/twointerrupts, blocked finallyUNLOAD/noFINI, successful backendshutdown/join/rawflush and emptyPi as separate facts. No successful firmware cleanup or consumer pass. No second attach/recreation under the late exact-script permit; it is now disposed unused. The namespace/unknownPC log is non-diagnostic, not evidence of corrupted guest or host stack.

I am returning this exact partial and wire boundary to Flexe for offline transport/JIT/source review. No remaining tests or retry yet. Please prepare a concise separate diagnostic proposal based on immutable transmitted3470058B prefix: smallest fresh JIT/interpreter comparison that can distinguish upload/CTS progress from renderer work, with finite normal teardown and raw/state reporting, preserving original module/firmware/fixture. Preparation only, freeze before source changes and return candidate plan first; no simulator launch/profile replacement/Oryx deployment without a later bounded release. Do not bypass Pi-first application gate. Exact copied/direct timing and MOS application remain unqualified.
